title: Reorder List
summary: Rearrange a list in place so it alternates first, last, second, second-to-last, and so on.

tests.explain: Take from the front and the back in turn: 1, 6, 2, 5, 3, 4. The test reads the list starting from your original head.
With an odd length, the middle node (30) ends up last.

hints: Write out the target order: the second half of the list is used backwards. What if you reversed the second half first?
Three steps: find the middle with slow and fast pointers, cut the list there and reverse the second half, then weave the two halves together.
While weaving, save both next pointers before you rewire: a.next = b, b.next = savedA, then move a and b to the saved nodes. Don't return anything; the head stays the head.

complexity.time: O(n): middle, reversal and weave are one pass each
complexity.space: O(1): nodes are rewired in place
